comments.body: My son is a third year student at the University of Waterloo who will be doing a year abroad at ETH this Fall. He has applied for housing via WOKO, but has not received an offer. His expectation is that WOKO will tell him his housing “placement”. After reading this post, I feel like he needs to be more proactive in his housing search. Is this process different for undergrads than grad students?
comments.author: Lukkwad1917
